candidate_scope: All 1502 preflight eligible UID planes; process all their current masked-on positive-opacity native primitives including original, inherited moment children, and exact-clip appended branches
coordinates: Shared car-reference plane from BUILD measured/proposal responsibilities; children deterministically derive from parent at actual native time, no new free temporal parameters
moment_source: Whiten each prepared native splat Gaussian with its original rotation/scales. For inherited clips, intersect the old camera plane (transformed to model coordinates) with the shared new plane. Use same covariance for probabilities and determinant factors.
clip_limit: Legacy clip-conditioning precision uses a variance floor; record its covariance/mean discrepancy from the unregularized splat. Do not reuse stale clip precision on new child geometry.
children: Two conditional moment-matched ordinary Gaussian children for resolved nonzero sides; source primitive mask exits. All new children clear old clip metadata and update center depth. Source SH/material is inherited without fitting.
degenerate_policy: Exact-empty or numerically tiny sides preserve the original full parent primitive and metadata as an unsplit protected component. These components do not participate in S/U; report their counts and contribution coverage. Numerical moment errors also preserve original primitives but block stage2 eligibility.

initialization.m: unconditional child probability Z_j * sqrt(det(original covariance)/det(child covariance))
initialization.opacity: a_child = 1 - (1 - a_parent)^m; a_parent=1 uses the limiting value1 for m>0; zero probability has no child
initialization.meaning: A fixed bounded optical-volume proxy initialization; not a proof of native projected alpha, alpha*T, RGB or depth conservation
initialization.diagnostics: Record linear-volume a_parent*m values above1 without clipping them into a candidate; record optical saturation and entry into native 0.99 cap. Infinite source optical depth has no finite conservation claim.
initialization.selection: Only this initialization is the R candidate; no image-dependent initialization choice, threshold or strength sweep

arms: R: full resolved children, no retirement
S conditional on R pass: retire replace-side resolved children50%
U conditional on R pass: retire both resolved children at BUILD target-alphaT dose matched to S
R_gate: all inherited full49 black/keep/delete protection and road/seam pooled guards
fixed measured-a6 parent depth mean absolute change<=0.005m per frame/state
known/outside parent alpha mean absolute change<=0.01
target PVD alphaT absolute change divided by fixed isolated target alpha<=0.01 per frame/state
no numerical moment errors, nonzero resolved-child target dose
stage2: Only run if the complete R gate passes. Use BUILD R-native joint alphaT of resolved keep/replace tags to compute one fixed global matched coefficient. Same R geometry/SH/opacity in S and U; no refitting.
failed_R: Save and reload parent/zero-operation. Stop moment-only pipeline without running S/U; bounded local response fitting is a separate future experiment.
domain: Fixed431 lower PVD and26229 target rays; no hidden RGB supervision or geometry accuracy inference from visible contribution
build: 40 original frames excluding repeated internal HELD
scope: Repeated same-scene mechanism probes; not untouched test data, independent generalization, a rigid immutable object asset or an opaque first-hit renderer
smoke: real parent-row identity parity all states
finite native output and unchanged source-model checks
evaluation and next-stage entry state saved
